Prime Time 45 IBU (5.4%)
Citra and Chinook, Nelson Sauvin and a special Kiwi hop blend hops. Bursts of citrus with tropical dank.
Scarlet Fire IPA (6.8%)
Our Flagship IPA. Brewed with First Wort Hopping. Full-bodied hop forward, Northwest IPA. Dry Hopped with Chinook and Cascade.
Coal Creek Porter (5.5% abv)
Dark and crystal malts gives our Porter a rich and smooth texture with a chocolaty finish. Hopped with Magnum, and Centennial.
Buck Mulligans Nitro Stout (4%)
A creamy and smooth stout with a nice roasted dry finish and a touch of chocolate. Served on Nitro.
Sour Smash (7.2%)
Oodles of Blackberry and a touch of Lime from Oregon Fruit Products. Tart and refreshing.
Dillan's Daily IPA (6.6%)
A crisp, bright West Coast IPA brewed in honor of our friend Dillan. Loaded with Citra, Chinook, El Dorado, and Azacca hops, this one brings a punch of citrus and tropical fruit up front, balanced by dank pine, resin, and a clean, snappy bitterness.
Kolsch Following (4.6%)
A Kölsch-style German Ale brewed with Best pilsen and wheat malts. Bittered with German Magnum and finished with Saaz hops. Clean, crisp, and delicately balanced. Finishes dry. Prost!
Hoponessa IPA (6%) 40 IBU
2-row, crystal, and wheat malts provide a rich body and a crisp finish. Hopped with Citra in the boil and loads more added in dry hops. Lychee and lemongrass added to the brite. A delectable beer in all rights.
Hoppy Hippy IPA (6.5%) 35 IBU
New Zealand hops. Tropical, citrusy goodness
